The structure of Cr3Si adopts the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a cell formula of Cr6Si2 and eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: each Cr center has 12 geometric neighbors (8 Cr, 4 Si) and each Si center has 12 Cr neighbors, with neighbor distances of 2.5222–2.7743 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3D component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among 12-vertex Cr polyhedra, plus edge and corner sharing between Cr and Si 12-vertex polyhedra.
